'''Tal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]] and [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] who was active during the [[Galactic War]]. She could often be found on [[Vaiken Spacedock]], selling gear to other agents.

==Behind the scenes==
Tal first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as "Quartermaster Tal", a Champion PvP Gear vendor for the Imperial Agent class. During a restructuring of the game's gear system in Game Update 2.0, she was changed to a Basic Gear vendor and retitled as "Agent Tal." She was later removed in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
